name: Elasticsearch Sink
shortDescription: Consume data from a Kafka topic in Quix write it to Elasticsearch.

Variables.Name: ELASTICSEARCH_CONNECTION
Variables.Description: Elasticsearch URL and authentication from a shared Variable Group.
Base URL of your Elasticsearch instance, including the scheme and port
Authentication settings as a JSON object, passed to the Elasticsearch client

Variables.Name: ELASTICSEARCH_MAPPING
Variables.Description: A mapping of field types for the given Elasticsearch Index; accepts a JSON-serializable string

Variables.Name: ELASTICSEARCH_BATCH_SIZE
Variables.Description: Integer for how large each chunk size is with bulk; ex; '500'

Variables.Name: ELASTICSEARCH_MAX_BULK_RETRIES
Variables.Description: Integer of retry attempts for each bulk batch; ex; '3'

Variables.Name: ELASTICSEARCH_IGNORE_BULK_UPLOAD_ERRORS
Variables.Description: Ignore any errors that occur when attempting an upload

Variables.Name: ELASTICSEARCH_ADD_MESSAGE_METADATA
Variables.Description: Include key, timestamp, and headers as '__{field}'

Variables.Name: ELASTICSEARCH_ADD_TOPIC_METADATA
Variables.Description: Include topic, partition, and offset as '__{field}'

Variables.Name: CONSUMER_GROUP_NAME
Variables.Description: The name of the consumer group to use when consuming from Kafka

Variables.Name: BUFFER_SIZE
Variables.Description: The number of records that sink waits before flushing data to Elasticsearch

Variables.Name: BUFFER_TIMEOUT
Variables.Description: The number of seconds that sink waits before flushing data to Elasticsearch
